lines.text: Amaziah the priest of Bethel tells King Jeroboam that Amos has conspired against him and says he will die by the sword.
Amaziah tells Amos to flee to the land of Egypt and never prophesy at Bethel again.
Amos replies that he was not a prophet or a prophet's son, but a herdsman and a tender of sycamore-fig trees.
Amos says King Uzziah took him from following the flock and told him to prophesy to Israel.
Amos declares the LORD's word to Amaziah: his sons and daughters will fall by the sword, and he will die on pagan soil.
